D: Three minions travel to 1968 Villain-Con looking for a new evil boss.
P: Serve the snacks when Kevin, Stuart and Bob arrive at Villain-Con.
S: Banana chunks in a light soda water batter, fried and drizzled with honey.

Banana chunks dipped in a light soda water batter, fried golden and crisp, drizzled with honey and sprinkled with crushed peanuts. Whisk 100g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp cornflour, 1 tbsp caster sugar and a pinch of salt with 170ml cold soda water into a smooth batter. Cut 4 firm bananas into 4cm chunks. Heat oil to 180C. Dip the banana in batter and fry in batches for 2 to 3 minutes until golden. Drain on paper towel, drizzle with honey and scatter with 50g crushed roasted peanuts. Eat while hot.
Franks in buns with beef chilli, cheddar and fried onions, messy enough to need a goggle wipe.

Grilled franks in soft buns loaded with quick beef chilli, melted cheddar, sticky fried onions and mustard, wrapped in paper. Fry 250g beef mince with half a diced onion, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp mild chilli powder, add 200g passata and simmer 15 minutes until thick. Slowly fry 2 sliced onions in butter for 15 minutes until golden. Grill 8 franks until they split. Split and toast 8 hot dog buns, add the franks, spoon over chilli, top with 100g grated cheddar, onions and mustard. Wrap in paper.
Kevin's cheddar and pecan cheese ball
Sharp cheddar and cream cheese rolled in toasted pecans, Ritz crackers, the swankiest snack in town.

Sharp cheddar beaten with cream cheese, Dijon and smoked paprika, shaped into a ball, chilled and rolled in toasted pecans, with Ritz crackers. Beat 250g softened cream cheese with 200g finely grated sharp cheddar, 1 tsp Dijon mustard and half a tsp smoked paprika until smooth. Shape into a ball, wrap and chill 1 hour. Toast 80g chopped pecans in a dry pan for 4 minutes, cool, and roll the ball in them. Serve with crackers.
M: Buttermilk chicken fried crisp, flaky biscuits and honey butter, finger food for a crowd in capes.

Chicken thighs soaked in buttermilk, dredged in seasoned flour and fried crisp, with flaky buttermilk scone biscuits and honey butter. Soak 1kg chicken thigh pieces in 500ml buttermilk with 1 tsp salt for 2 hours. Mix 250g plain flour with 2 tsp sweet paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper. Dredge the chicken and fry at 170°C for 12 minutes until golden and cooked through. Rub 80g cold butter into 300g self-raising flour, stir in 220ml buttermilk, pat out 3cm thick, cut 8 rounds and bake at 220°C for 14 minutes. Beat 60g soft butter with 2 tbsp honey.
Ground beef loaf under a sticky ketchup glaze, mashed potatoes and gravy, invented in the groovy lab.

Beef mince, onion, egg and breadcrumbs baked in a loaf tin under a tomato sauce and brown sugar glaze, sliced thick with mashed potatoes and gravy. Mix 800g beef mince with 1 grated onion, 1 egg, 60g breadcrumbs, 60ml milk, 1 tsp salt and pepper and press into a loaf tin. Stir 80ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar and spread on top. Bake at 180°C for 1 hour, then rest 10 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes for 20 minutes and mash with 50g butter and 100ml milk. Make up the gravy and serve.
W: Bananas split under vanilla ice cream and hot chocolate fudge.

Bananas split lengthways with three scoops of ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream and a cherry. Heat 150ml cream and pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate, stirring into hot fudge. Split 4 bananas lengthways into long dishes. Add three scoops of vanilla ice cream to each, pour over the fudge and top with whipped cream and a maraschino cherry.
K: Banana, vanilla ice cream, milk and caramel sauce, blended thick.

Ripe bananas blended with vanilla ice cream, cold milk and caramel sauce until thick, topped with whipped cream and a banana slice. Blend 3 ripe bananas with 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 400ml cold milk and 3 tbsp caramel sauce until thick and smooth. Drizzle a little more caramel inside 4 tall glasses and pour in the shake. Top each with a swirl of whipped cream, a banana slice and a final drizzle of caramel. Serve with wide straws.

dishes.make_ahead: Crush the peanuts up to 3 days ahead; whisk the batter, cut the bananas and fry just before serving

steps.text: Whisk the flour, cornflour, sugar, salt and soda water into a smooth batter.
Cut the bananas into chunks and crush the peanuts.
Heat the oil to 180C.
Dip the banana in batter and fry in batches.
Drain, drizzle with honey and scatter with peanuts.

dishes.n: Kevin's cheddar and pecan cheese ball
dishes.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, wrapped and chilled; roll in the pecans to serve

steps.text: Beat the cream cheese, cheddar, mustard and paprika until smooth.
Shape into a ball, wrap and chill 1 hour.
Toast the pecans in a dry pan until fragrant, then cool.
Roll the ball in the pecans and serve with the crackers.

dishes.make_ahead: Soak the chicken up to a day ahead in the fridge; bake the biscuits and fry the chicken on the day

steps.text: Soak the chicken in 500ml of the buttermilk with 1 tsp salt for 2 hours in the fridge.
Rub 80g of the cold butter into the self-raising flour, stir in the rest of the buttermilk, pat out 3cm thick and cut 8 rounds.
Bake the biscuits at 220°C until risen and golden.
Mix the plain flour with the paprika, garlic powder, 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper, and heat the oil to 170°C.
Dredge the chicken and fry in batches until golden and cooked through.
Beat the rest of the butter with the honey and serve with the chicken and biscuits.

veg.make_ahead: Soak the cauliflower up to a day ahead in the fridge; bake the biscuits and fry on the day

steps.text: Soak the cauliflower in 500ml of the buttermilk with 1 tsp salt for 1 hour in the fridge.
Rub 80g of the cold butter into the self-raising flour, stir in the rest of the buttermilk, pat out 3cm thick and cut 8 rounds.
Bake the biscuits at 220°C until risen and golden.
Mix the plain flour with the paprika, garlic powder, 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper, and heat the oil to 170°C.
Dredge the cauliflower and fry in batches until golden and tender.
Beat the rest of the butter with the honey and serve with the cauliflower and biscuits.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the fudge sauce up to 5 days ahead, keep chilled and reheat gently; whip the cream and assemble on the night

ingredients.item: thickened cream, whipped, for the topping

steps.text: Chop the chocolate. Heat the cream for the fudge and pour over the chocolate, stirring into a hot fudge.
Heat.
Whip the cream for the topping. Split the bananas lengthways into long dishes.
Add three scoops of ice cream to each, pour over the fudge and top with cream and a cherry.

dishes.make_ahead: Best blended just before serving; chill the tall glasses in the freezer up to 2 hours ahead

steps.text: Blend the bananas, ice cream, milk and some of the caramel until thick and smooth.
Drizzle caramel inside four tall glasses and pour in the shake.
Top with whipped cream, a banana slice and a final drizzle of caramel.
